Here’s a list of many of the known med-spa and spa / wellness franchise brands operating in the United States. I’m not claiming this is *literally every* med spa franchise (because new ones launch regularly and some are small/regional) — but it is a fairly broad sampling of major and mid-size players as referenced across recent 2025 franchise-industry guides.  

---

## ✅ Examples of U.S. Med-Spa & Spa Franchises

| Franchise / Brand | Notes / What they Offer |
|---|---|
| **entity["brand","Ideal Image Medspa",0]** | National aesthetic medspa franchise offering laser hair removal, body contouring, injectables, CoolSculpting, and general anti-aging services. citeturn0search9turn0search8 |
| **entity["brand","Radiance Medspa",0]** | Medspa offering non-surgical aesthetic procedures; frequently cited among spa-franchise listings. citeturn0search6turn0search12 |
| **entity["brand","V/O Med Spa",0]** | Boutique-style med spa franchise, specializing in anti-aging and body contouring treatments. citeturn0search6turn0search12 |
| **entity["brand","Pure Vanity",0]** | Spa franchise offering skin care, laser hair removal, body work, and other aesthetic services. citeturn0search6turn0search9 |
| **entity["brand","Kalologie 360 Spa",0]** | Full-service spa franchise offering massage, facials, waxing, skin care products, tanning, and body treatments. citeturn0search6turn0search9 |
| **entity["brand","Massage Envy",0]** | Large national chain primarily known for massage and skin care, but many locations now offer spa-style and esthetic/facial treatments. citeturn0search37turn0search18 |
| **entity["brand","Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa",0]** | Spa and facial-focused franchise with extensive U.S. footprint. citeturn0search38turn0search9 |
| **entity["brand","BodEnvy Med Spa",0]** | Listed among current U.S.-based medspa franchise business opportunities (non-invasive body sculpting, weight-loss focused). citeturn0search2 |
| **entity["brand","Sapphira Privé Med Spa",0]** | Another med-spa franchise opportunity frequently cited in 2025 franchise-market overviews. citeturn0search2turn0search4 |
| **entity["brand","Skinovatio Medical Spa",0]** | Medspa franchise offering aesthetic and wellness services, included in recent “top-opportunity” lists. citeturn0search1turn0search2 |
| **entity["brand","dermani MEDSPA",0]** | Spa / medspa franchise opportunity listed among medspa business offerings in the U.S. citeturn0search2turn0search3 |
| **entity["brand","Live Hydration Spa",0]** | Wellness/IV-hydration spa franchise (adjacent to medspa/wellness space) included among spa-franchise listings. citeturn0search2 |

---

## 🔎 Notes & Why the List Isn’t Exhaustive

- “Med-spa franchise” means different things depending on the brand — some (like Ideal Image, Radiance, V/O) lean heavily into medical-grade aesthetic services (injectables, laser, body-contouring, etc.), while others (like Massage Envy, Hand & Stone, Kalologie) may lean more toward general spa, massage, facial, or wellness services, sometimes with add-on “medical spa–style” treatments. Because of that variety, some directory sources mix pure med-spa, wellness-spa, and hybrid franchises.  

- The spa/medspa market is dynamic. New franchises or hybrid wellness-aesthetic models become available over time. Some older franchises might shut down, rebrand, or evolve. Most public lists come from franchise-opportunity directories or industry summary reports rather than an official central registry.  

- For investment or comparative purposes (given your background working with aesthetic practices), it is often helpful to cross-reference these franchise names with their Franchise Disclosure Documents (FDDs) and real-world location data — because “franchise opportunity listed” does not guarantee they are still expanding in a given state or have strong brand presence nationwide.

---

## 🎯 Relevance to Your Work & What to Watch

Given your background helping med spas and aesthetic practices grow via marketing, operations, and strategy:  

- Many of the above franchises include services similar to what your clients (like Andrea Pryor’s new wellness/HRT + aesthetics practice) are offering. Studying them could reveal competitive positioning, pricing strategy, service menu structures, or marketing tactics to borrow or benchmark.  
- If you're considering approaching franchise-owner practices as potential podcast guests or consulting clients, these names are likely to be relevant starting points.  
- Because franchises often provide turnkey systems (brand recognition, marketing support, training, supply chain), they contrast sharply with independent, founder-led practices — which means valuable differentiation could come from personalization, brand voice, and the “values-driven, woman-over-40” aesthetic you already specialize in.

---

If you like, I can **pull up a full spreadsheet** of 30–50 U.S. med-spa franchises (with **year founded**, **number of units**, **typical investment cost range**, and **services offered**) — that might be useful as a master reference for you.  
Do you want me to build that for you now?
